description: Reusable public claims about PARASOL. Every figure on a page should trace to an entry here, with its source and review date.

facts.claim: In AY 2025-26 the platform hosted more than 140 classes, 75 instructors, and 18,000 student enrollments.
Four new GPU servers with a total of 32 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, increasing peak instructional AI computing capacity by nearly four times.
